_help: Source of truth for the player art. mem/player.mem is GENERATED from this file + the PNGs.
Rows are numbered 1-4 (top to bottom), columns 0-3 (left to right) inside a sheet.
Anything missing / transparent / wrong size falls back to mem/player_v1.mem (old art) with a warning.
forms.N.scale = exact integer upscale of every sheet of that form about the cell centre (1 = as drawn, 2 = each pixel becomes 2x2). Pixels that would leave the 32x32 frame are cut off and reported.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.

4._note: no own art yet: the Human sheets recoloured gold (see tints). Replace these paths with picture/form4_walk.png etc. when you have art, and remove tint.

tints._help: tint = recolour by luminance: black outlines stay dark, everything else is a ramp from dark to light. Used per form with forms.N.tint

overrides._example_1: "form2.left.A": [2, 1]  = row 2, col 1 of the walk sheet
overrides._example_2: "form3.up.B": {"skip": true}  = use old art for that one frame
